description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing global configuration settings in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving and updating global configuration parameters, with support for fetching by ID or name, and handles JSON serialization/deserialization. The class is annotated for Swagger documentation and uses JAX-RS annotations for REST endpoints.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing global configuration settings, including retrieval and update endpoints, with Swagger annotations for documentation.

methods.name: retrieveConfiguration
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the list of global configuration settings, with optional survey parameter.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific global configuration by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveOneByName
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a global configuration by its name.

methods.name: updateConfiguration
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a global configuration identified by its ID.

methods.name: updateConfigurationByName
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a global configuration identified by its name.
